title: Count Almost Equal Pairs I
summary: Count index pairs i < j where the two numbers become equal after at most one swap of two digits in one of them. Leading zeros are allowed after a swap.
officialConstraints: 2 <= nums.length <= 100 and 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6 (search summary citing leetcode.com).
examples: nums = [123, 231] -> 0 (search summary citing leetcode.com). The leading-zero example [100, 1] is illustrative (not from the statement).
visualizationNotes: Playback accepts 12 numbers up to 999999. Each number's one-swap reach is built and checked against earlier numbers.
